answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one vertex weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The zephyr report shows the merge explicitly at each jetty. Because of that, an attacker who spins up 59 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 63 times the capital for one share. A farm of 1104 identities would post 1365 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
